article.headline: Portland opens the year with a 133-89 win over Willamette
article.description: — Timo George’s 19 points helped Portland open the year with a 133-89 victory over Willamette on Monday.
article.linkText: Portland opens the year with a 133-89 win over Willamette
article.story: PORTLAND, Ore. -- — Timo George’s 19 points helped Portland open the year with a 133-89 victory over Willamette on Monday. George added six rebounds for the Pilots. James O’Donnell scored 18 points and added 10 rebounds. R.J. Nance had 15 points and shot 6 for 10 from the field, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Tanner Overby led the Bearcats with 17 points, seven assists and two steals. Willamette also got 12 points from Kellen Sande. Anujan Tennathur finished with 11 points. Up next Portland visits UT Arlington on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
